study.question: Does actual click-label alignment improve target-aware history learning once the auxiliary common-shift gradient is removed, relative to exact expected-permutation regularization with identical capacity and training exposure?
study.hypothesis: Observation: baseline-static/pooled/din AUCs are 0.6050036145/0.6102261137/0.6133619861. Native aligned history supervision g3-r0000-history_aux reached 0.6129014321, below baseline, while g3-r0001-expected_permuted reached 0.6136336662. Native fixed routed 0.6078643414 and fixed mean-only 0.6065947536 were strongly adverse; centering rescued fixed/learned arms to 0.6134685792/0.6134639076. This locally supports sensitivity to calibration/gradient routing but does not establish useful label acquisition. Hypothesis: an aligned label-covariance term added to the centered expected-label loss can supply discriminative history gradients without the common-shift pressure of native auxiliary BCE. The previous aligned failure warrants this controlled follow-up rather than a conclusion that true supervision cannot help. All observed improvements remain single-seed and provisional.

nearest_work.source_ref: paper:din, arxiv:1706.06978v4, archived text sha256 83fb9eeca31e2fa3c557b6f08b893ad0018cefb33da6e00952136b9ce17e607e, lines 270-316
nearest_work.difference: Inherit local target-aware activation concept via the existing field-adapted reference. That reference uses normalized softmax and category/brand/action/age embeddings, whereas DIN explicitly relaxes softmax normalization. DIN minibatch-aware parameter L2 is not this representation companion loss. No exact DIN reproduction or new attention architecture is claimed.

nearest_work.source_ref: https://proceedings.mlr.press/v38/lee15a.pdf ; Lee et al., Deeply-Supervised Nets, AISTATS 2015, section 2, pp. 563-565
nearest_work.difference: Companion supervision at hidden representations is inherited prior art. Here one training-only binary head supervises the existing target-aware history pool; differentiable batch-logit centering permits an exact aligned-versus-expected-label contrast. No claim that auxiliary supervision itself is new, or that image-domain benefits transfer.

nearest_work.source_ref: https://cdn.aaai.org/ojs/4545/4545-13-7584-1-10-20190706.pdf ; Zhou et al., DIEN, AAAI 2019, Interest Extractor Layer, pp. 5943-5944, equations 6-7
nearest_work.difference: DIEN supervises GRU interest states with consecutive behavior and sampled item negatives. This study retains a pooled attention reference and uses only current training impression click labels; it invents neither item identities nor next-behavior labels. Centered alignment is not a DIEN replication.

nearest_work.source_ref: paper:dmr, author README text sha256 656c9e5eec79c9843e907a555ede2bf0a66a0db3515916af3d655080057c5a75, lines 4-8
nearest_work.difference: The inspected author README confirms category/brand/action histories lack item IDs. Publisher full text remains unavailable through the registry; no detailed DMR loss equivalence or novelty distinction is asserted.

Direct source ancestor supplies backbone, centered expected-label loss, fixed-versus-learned head switches and label-free diagnostics. Proposed difference is subtracting empirical training label/logit covariance, not a new backbone or a claim of broad novelty.

inherited_components: Complete field-adapted DIN reference initialization order, encoding and inference graph from baseline_reference.py; normalized target-aware pooling is acknowledged as an adaptation.
577-parameter auxiliary MLP allocated after backbone construction inside torch.random.fork_rng(devices=[]), preserving CPU RNG and primary backbone initialization.
Centered loss C=E softplus(c+u)-softplus(c), u=z-Ez, c=logit(clamp(q)), q=nonempty current training-batch prevalence; final auxiliary bias bypassed as in parent.
Frozen host training, causal histories, full-population validation AUC/Logloss, predefined slices and measured cost fields.
Existing candidate-supplied shape/Jacobian/covariance diagnostics on the first 512 validation impressions; these are descriptive, not probes of validation labels.
study.proposed_difference: Add A=E[(y-q)u] over nonempty TRAINING histories to obtain Laux=C-A. Algebraically C-A=BCE(c+u,y)-BCE(c,y), including clipped q through c, since E[u]=0. Exact permutation expectation has E[A]=0 and is the registered no-alignment control. The loss is invariant to a common auxiliary logit shift and projects out its gradient. It does not imply that nonconstant centered logits have calibrated average predictions. Implement aligned learned/routed candidate, aligned fixed/routed control, aligned learned/blocked control, and a learned/routed expected-label reproduction control; combine with existing fixed expected-label parent for the alignment x head-adaptability factorial. This is a local training-signal contrast. Broad novelty is unverified. Primary loss and all inference computation stay inherited. Training-only detached summary buffers accumulate gap/covariance/loss/prevalence without storing samples; diagnostics label these historical training measurements explicitly.
predictions: Primary planned contrast: aligned_learned validation AUC exceeds expected_control and its g3-r0003-centered_learned ancestor; require the improvement to survive later paired seeds before declaring repeated support. Compare with the stronger native incumbent g3-r0001-expected_permuted as a separate quality-selection gate.

If aligned signal is useful independent of head adaptability, aligned_fixed minus g3-r0003-centered_fixed is also favorable. A learned-only improvement indicates an interaction, not universal history benefit.

aligned_blocked should reproduce baseline-din primary predictions and AUC/Logloss under seed 42 despite fitting its head; drift outside reproducibility tolerance invalidates attribution pending source and host investigation.

expected_control should reproduce g3-r0003-centered_learned AUC 0.6134639075600551 and Logloss 0.19672102238123018 within host numerical repeatability. Extra summaries are detached, contain no RNG, and cannot change the optimized null loss.

If the actual training signal is acquired, historical training covariance can become positive and centered auxiliary loss can decrease; this is optimization evidence only. Norm, trace, rank and entropy are descriptive and cannot establish label information or mediation.

No auxiliary branch executes in eval forward. Expected parameter count remains 17130852; all four arms allocate identical parameters and only 577 auxiliary parameters are potentially optimized. Fixed head freezes its shape, and its unused output bias has no gradient. Wall/peak-memory/throughput/latencies must be measured by host; no efficiency result is assumed.

Use the existing predefined history-length, action-presence, hour, category-match and user-training-frequency slices with sample/positive/negative counts. In particular history_1_16 has only 1444 positives; sparse-slice changes remain exploratory. No new validation-driven bins.
falsifiers: If aligned_learned matches or underperforms expected_control, this implementation does not support beneficial centered label alignment even if training covariance grows.

If aligned_blocked changes the primary trajectory, or expected_control fails reproduction beyond host numerical tolerance, reject the intended attribution until implementation/host differences are resolved; do not count these as scientific positives.
If label alignment helps only against the centered control but not baseline or the native incumbent, report local conditional support without selecting it as best model.
If any benefit vanishes across paired seeds or has unresolved user-cluster uncertainty, retain a preliminary/null conclusion rather than mechanism confirmation.

Centering rescuing a fixed head is not proof that common-shift gradients caused the earlier aligned-head failure; a centering x alignment interaction and further repetitions are required. Failure of this design does not refute all auxiliary supervision.
alternative_explanations: One-seed selection noise, finite temporal validation drift, and repeated-user dependence can explain small AUC differences. Re-running the same seed is a reproduction control, not independent evidence.

Centered normalization changes batch gradient coupling and effective loss scale, not just an interpretable calibration burden. C-A and C isolate label covariance at identical centering, but comparison with native BCE retains these coupled effects.

Target-aware pooled history includes target-conditioned attention and shares category/brand embeddings with static inputs. Benefits may reflect target or shared-embedding regularization; they do not prove extraction of uniquely historical causal information.

Fixed and learned heads have equal allocated capacity but different trainable freedom. Learned shape can attenuate/saturate, fixed projection can conflict with the main loss, and head nonlinearities can make scale comparisons imperfect.

Historical train summaries average nonstationary checkpoints and cannot validate generalization. Existing first-512 validation diagnostics may be unrepresentative. Publisher user/ad snapshot as-of dates are undocumented; the frozen static-snapshot assumption remains a limitation.
The new arms are not guaranteed equal GPU time despite matched epochs/passes and allocated capacity; use measured cost as an additional criterion. No unsupported equal-compute or significance claim.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: Frozen protocol estimated_unit_seconds=704.372973, trial_cap_seconds=1760.932432; recent comparable full runs 598.95-627.55 s. Runtime remaining_seconds=75304.632 at proposal preparation. Four variants estimated 2817.49 s; aggregate hard trial caps 7043.73 s. Preparation/source checks/diagnostics/reproductions/failures also consume the existing budget; no local training or installation.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Reserve at least six capped full units (10565.59 s) for discriminating follow-up or matched controls if the current contrast is consequential; do not use automatic retries after unknown execution state.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve at least eighteen capped full units (31696.78 s) for validation-only paired seeds 42/43/44 for a frozen candidate, native incumbent, baseline and decisive controls, including possible failures. Final suite and hashes must be frozen before assessment; no test interface is available. These are prospective reservations, not authorization to train in the coding phase.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Stop at any host hard limit, integrity failure, explicit stop, or when no admissible discriminating run fits after reserves. No blind loss-weight sweep. If screening is null, preserve all failures and retain existing incumbent without claiming scientific success. No new runtime budget, protocol, data, scorer, or holdout access.
